sentences.l2: 随着独生子女政策的逐步调整，越来越多的家庭迎来了二胎甚至三孩。
sentences.l1: As the one-child policy has gradually been adjusted, more and more families have welcomed a second child, or even a third.

sentences.l2: 三孩政策的出台，让许多曾经的独生子女第一次体会到"手足"二字的分量。
sentences.l1: The introduction of the three-child policy has let many former only children experience for the first time the weight of the word "siblings".

sentences.l2: 对不少"80后""90后"而言，他们成长于独享父母全部关爱的环境，如今却要学着与弟弟妹妹分享玩具、时间与关注。
sentences.l1: For many of the "post-80s" and "post-90s", they grew up in an environment of enjoying all of their parents' love alone, and now have to learn to share toys, time and attention with younger brothers and sisters.

sentences.l2: 这种转变并非总是轻松的。
sentences.l1: This change is not always easy.

sentences.l2: 父母在养育多个孩子时，难免因精力有限而有所侧重，年长的孩子常会感到某种程度的"偏心"，心里泛起失落与委屈。
sentences.l1: When parents raise several children, it is inevitable that, because their energy is limited, they favour some more than others, and the older child often feels a certain degree of "favouritism", with disappointment and grievance rising in the heart.

sentences.l2: 然而，手足之情也在摩擦中悄然生长。
sentences.l1: However, sibling affection also quietly grows amid friction.

sentences.l2: 当哥哥姐姐学会照顾年幼的弟妹，当兄弟姐妹在生活的风雨中彼此扶持，那份血脉相连的默契便愈发深厚。
sentences.l1: When older brothers and sisters learn to look after their younger siblings, and when brothers and sisters support one another through life's storms, that tacit understanding of being related by blood grows ever deeper.

sentences.l2: 独生子女曾经的孤独，或许正被这份热闹而复杂的亲情悄然填补。
sentences.l1: The loneliness that only children once felt is perhaps being quietly filled by this lively and complicated family affection.
